remarks:
Excellent investment opportunity!! This well-maintained double features two updated units with great tenants (that would like to stay)providing immediate rental income. Regular maintenance of the furnace and hot water tanks. New gutters on the whole house within the past 2 years, 30 year arch roof (approx 15 years old), freshly landscaped every year, newly painted front porch and rear deck. Enjoy the quiet neighborhood from your front porch and the privacy of your beautiful yard from the back yard deck!
Lower has wonderful living room with beautiful natural woodwork that opens to a great room/kitchen. Original natural wood, leaded glass, hardwood floors, some newer laminate flooring, all beautifully maintained. The kitchen is loaded with cabinets, great counter space and an island. There are two good-sized bedrooms and a full bathroom w/separate shower and jetted tub. The upper apartment also has 2 bedrooms, a living area and kitchen.  The full basement provides the convenience of a washer & dryer for both tenants to use.  The yard is fenced and has a huge deck for both tenants to enjoy for outdoor entertainment.  This property presents a compelling opportunity. Located in the heart of Lovejoy, residents enjoy convenient access to neighborhood shops, restaurants, schools, parks, public transportation, and major commuter routes. The area is known for its strong sense of community, walkable residential streets, and proximity to downtown Buffalo.  Nearby shopping, everyday conveniences, and easy access to the Kensington Expressway make commuting throughout Western New York simple and efficient. Thank you for considering 311 Ideal Street for your next real estate investment!
